d: The United States has launched fresh strikes on Iran, with explosions reported near the strategic Strait of Hormuz. Tehran has warned that European military bases could become targets if they are used to support American attacks. As tensions rise, is the conflict threatening to spread beyond West Asia? In this edition of Firstpost Live This Week, we look at the biggest global developments of the last seven days — from Iran's escalating confrontation with the United States to Donald Trump's midterm setback, Wall Street's massive selloff and Benjamin Netanyahu's fight to hold on to power.…
